source: Release review, 11 Nov 2026: names the head's training table has wrong outside Ithomiini. Dismorphia and Moschoneura (Dismorphiinae) are not Pierini, Doxocopa (Apaturinae) is not Limenitidini, «Satyrini, Subtribe Euptychiina» is a subtribe written as a tribe, and Libytheidae is the old family rank of Libytheinae. The wrong tribe is left out (missing, not wrong) until a corrected full table is applied; Libytheana gets Libytheinae.
